review_description: TAB have been great, unfortunately the Solar Edge system was trash and required 3x new inverters over the course of 4 years. TAB were fantastic with attending site and installing the new inverters but the problem was getting the warranty claims with SolarEdge, their customer service was a poor as their ability to ship replacement parts in a timely fashion.To be clear - none of my grievances are to do with the installer, they are solely with SolarEdge and their support products and customer service
